reference_MSA_GAP_IDX: reference the MSA_GAP_IDX constant to get the gap index in the protein one-letter alphabet
use_NUM_SEQ_NUM_RES_MSA_FEATURES: use the NUM_SEQ_NUM_RES_MSA_FEATURES tuple to identify MSA features with sequence and residue dimensions
use_NUM_SEQ_MSA_FEATURES: use the NUM_SEQ_MSA_FEATURES tuple to identify MSA features with only a sequence dimension
reference_TEMPLATE_FEATURES: reference the TEMPLATE_FEATURES tuple to get the list of template-related feature names
use_MSA_PAD_VALUES: use the MSA_PAD_VALUES dict to get default padding values for MSA feature arrays
